name: The Altered Mise en Place
description: Commit in deploy.sh with the message 'cleaning up redundant logs'. A single added line redirects auth_check's stderr to /dev/null with || true, silencing authentication failures and causing fail-open.
devil_advocate: The change looks like a readability improvement, but its effect is to silence authentication errors. A commit with such small surface and such high impact requires adversarial review.

custodyEvents.detail: Post-deploy auth-failure spike with zero alerts flagged the discrepancy.
Git history, diff, and auth log acquired.
Deterministic engine ran over the acquired artifacts.

artifacts.description: Commit 'Cleaning up redundant logs'. +1 line, 0 removed. Author: devops@corp.com. The commit message documents an innocuous change; the actual diff does something else entirely — a fabricated record of intent.
Added line: 'auth_check() 2>/dev/null || true'. Silences pam_authenticate; if there's an error, it continues as if nothing happened. Context — the mechanism, not itself a scored contributor.

47 authentication failures in the post-deploy window. No 4625 event generated. The authentication module's alerting was silenced going forward — functionally equivalent to clearing the trail for everything after the deploy.

peirce_chain.secondness: The added line silences authentication errors and forces fail-open.
peirce_chain.thirdness: A minimal change with maximum security impact, disguised as a refactor.

demo_quote: A single line can open a door. VELO detects that the surface of the change doesn't match its impact on the authentication function.
